ERR_SHD_TIMEOUT.description: Shadow execution exceeded maximum latency budget (default 500ms)
ERR_SHD_TIMEOUT.handling: Cancel background thread/task, log SHADOW_TIMEOUT telemetry, return legacy result

ERR_SHD_EXCEPTION.description: Unhandled exception inside shadow orchestrator or adapters
ERR_SHD_EXCEPTION.handling: Catch exception, log SHADOW_ERROR telemetry, return legacy result

ERR_SHD_PII.description: PII detected in shadow request payload
ERR_SHD_PII.handling: Reject shadow request, log PII_REJECTED event, return legacy result

ERR_SHD_EMERGENCY.handling: Skip shadow execution entirely, return legacy result
